title: Decision: decode_utf8_chunk two-phase raw_buf/buf split for multi-byte codepoints
description: The two-buffer approach in subscribe_events (raw_buf for incoming bytes, buf for decoded UTF-8) correctly handles multi-byte codepoints split across HTTP chunks. Without raw_buf, a codepoint split at a chunk boundary would either produce a UTF-8 error or silently corrupt the stream. The 7 unit tests in decode_utf8_chunk cover all cases (complete, incomplete head, split across chunks, definitively invalid). A future contributor might simplify this to from_utf8_lossy (which replaces invalid bytes with U+FFFD) — resist this: SSE protocol text must not have replacement characters inserted, as they corrupt the JMAP JSON payload. The current design is correct and its tests are the specification.
